newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EMU compromise plan for Italy under consideration.
newsitem.headline: EMU compromise plan for Italy under consideration.

text.p: European Union monetary officials said on Wednesday that a compromise plan that would allow Italy to join the monetary union after 1999 is under consideration in certain quarters.
"I can't confirm to which extent this is something which has been completely worked out, but in some quarters people are definitely thinking about this," a senior EU official said.
The Financial Times reported on Wednesday that Italy will be offered a deal which would delay its entry into economic and monetary union until 2000 or 2001.

Without specifically naming which countries might be considering such an option, the source said it was among those "which have an interest to start (EMU) with a hard core of countries," a clear reference to Germany.

Officials also said such an option had to be realistic and credible and would likely be spelled out in more detail ahead of early 1998 when the EU will decide on which countries qualify for the common currency.
